note: Kenya, read on the Directorate of Immigration Services' own pages (immigration.go.ke, fetched on 2026-10-30 with the server's missing intermediate certificate completed from its issuer) and its Service Delivery Charter 2025 (July 2025, the latest found). This replaces the file held in wave 8, whose permanent residence time (24 months) sat on the charter's 'Ex Citizens' line, not the permanent residence row: no time is written for permanent residence now. The Class D (employment) permit is issued to a person offered specific employment by a specific employer (work for the sponsor); its issuance fee is KSh 500,000 a year (kept), with a non-refundable KSh 20,000 processing fee on top that the form's one fee doesn't hold, and nothing for East African Community nationals; the charter gives 21 working days for a work or residence permit and 10 for a renewal (renewable kept from the class page's 'in case of permit renewal'). Applications are made online on the eFNS portal; the pages don't fix where from, so 'either' (a reading). Lawful residents who have held work permits for at least seven years and lived in Kenya continuously for the three years before applying may ask for permanent residence (7 kept on the Class D route); they apply online, pay KSh 50,000 to process, attend an interview in person and pay KSh 750,000 once approved (the issuing fee kept; read as applied for in Kenya, the applicant having to be resident). The Special Pass (up to six months to conduct business, trade or a profession temporarily, USD 200 a month, 7 working days) isn't written: the page doesn't say what work it allows, and its fee is in dollars. Whether a permit's years count toward naturalisation isn't on these pages.

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services (Kenya), Class D: (Employment)
sources.said: This permit is issued to a person who is offered specific employment by a specific employer, who is in possession of skills or qualifications that are not available in Kenya and whose engagement in that employment will be of benefit to Kenya. ... Valid Tax Compliance Certificate for company (new application), and/or valid Tax Compliance Certificates (for company and individual) in case of permit renewal ... Fee: Processing- Kshs. 20,000 non-refundable ... Issuance- Kshs. 500,000 per year ... East Africa Community Member States – Gratis

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services (Kenya), Lawful Residents (Category B)
sources.said: Lawful residents who have held work permits for a minimum of seven (7) years and have been resident in Kenya continuously for three (3) years preceding the application are eligible to apply for Permanent Residence. ... applicants are required to appear in person for interview to confirm or verify these facts. ... online payment acknowledgment for processing fee of Kshs 50,000 ... Once approved there is a requisite fee of 750,000

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services (Kenya), Special Pass
sources.said: Authorization issued to a foreigner who wishes to enter and remain in Kenya for a period not exceeding 6 months, for the purpose of temporarily conducting business, trade, or profession. ... Non-East Africans – 200 US Dollars per month upon approval

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services (Kenya), Service Delivery Charter 2025
sources.said: Issuance of Work / Residence ... Online application Processing Fees:Classes 21 working days ... Renewal: 10
